text: Asthenia [Gr. a + sqenoV , strength]: Ger. Asthenie ; Fr. asthénie ; Ital. astenia . Lack or impairment of strength or vitality; general debility; also used in combination, as in neurasthenia, lack of nervous vigour. The term angiosthenia is used for lack of muscular force. ( J.J . - E.M .)
